prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph so code, agent context, preview, skills, and tests are readable layers hinged over one shared Workspace board.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop web app, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: A persistent left rail approximately 250px groups Repositories and nested Workspaces and never moves. The main Workspace uses one base live-browser board with a single clear active layer for code and agent annotations. A stepped inner tab rail exposes Files, Changes, Preview, Skills, and Runs; the current tab extends and colors the board. Compact top chrome contains Sylph, repository, branch and search. The browser remains large and visibly live beneath the active layer.
Content: Repository `folkhero-web`; Workspaces `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`; task `Polish the onboarding flow`; browser preview shows a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen; active translucent layer contains `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, one concise code diff and agent note `Testing the corrected mobile flow`; state `Browser checks 4/4`; tabs `Files`, `Changes`, `Preview`, `Skills`, `Runs`.
Style/medium: Contemporary software manual system using milk-acetate transparency, precise Univers-like sans heads, a highly readable serif only for long agent explanation, mono for code, section-color boards, punched tab logic. It should feel systematic and modern, not vintage.
Composition/framing: Persistent left navigation is unmistakable. One clear top layer only; live browser is visible at scale below it. Use plane depth, hinge edges, tab extent and typographic columns, not rounded cards.
Lighting/mood: Bright, exact, quietly tactile.
Color palette: warm field #F2EDDF, ink #171717, chrome yellow #F2C319, teal #16999D, ultramarine #2454A6. One section hue dominates at a time.
Materials/textures: milk acetate, matte section board, crisp print ink, shallow punched holes.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Repositories`, `Workspaces`, `folkhero-web`, `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, `Testing the corrected mobile flow`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Files`, `Changes`, `Preview`, `Skills`, `Runs`.
Constraints: Must read as an agentic remote IDE with persistent left navigation and a first-class live browser. Dense but readable. Accessible contrast. No fake claims.
Avoid: loose paper collage, physical book mockup, documentation site, dashboard cards, generic dark IDE, glassmorphism, neon, excessive rounded corners, marketing page, device frame, tiny illegible text.
